info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: list returns every chat transport with the caller org's facts attached.
get.description:
list returns every chat transport with the caller org's facts attached.

The registry is closed and the order is fixed, so an unconnected transport is
still listed — with connected:false, its default policy, and no account.
Each row carries the org's connection, its DM and group policy, and how many
pairing requests are waiting for an admin.

get.summary: allowlist returns one channel's access policy for the caller's org.
get.description:
allowlist returns one channel's access policy for the caller's org.

It answers with both allow sources: the config-source entries this surface
owns, and the pairing-source entries approving a pairing minted, which are
read-only here.
A channel outside the closed transport registry is not found.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel is the transport id: discord, slack, teams or telegram.

put.summary: setAllowlist edits one channel's access policy and returns it as it now stands.
put.description:
setAllowlist edits one channel's access policy and returns it as it now stands.

It is admin-gated: a SuperAdmin, or an admin of the caller's own org.
The edit is partial — an omitted policy or a null list is left exactly as it
was — and it owns the CONFIG source only, so a policy write can never revoke
an approved pairing.
The answer is the same shape the read returns, so both verbs speak one shape.

get.summary: inbox returns the org's stored inbound messages, oldest first.
get.description:
inbox returns the org's stored inbound messages, oldest first.

It is a cursor read: pass the cursor a page returns back as since to get the
next one, and an empty page returns the cursor it was given.
Only the caller's own org's messages are ever visible.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Since is the exclusive row-id cursor to resume from; 0 starts at the oldest.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned; 0 takes the store's own default.

get.summary: pairing returns the org's pending, unexpired pairing requests.
get.description:
pairing returns the org's pending, unexpired pairing requests.

A code is a capability string an org member shows an admin to be approved, so
it is returned here and never logged.
Expired requests are not listed.

post.summary: approve turns a pending pairing code into a standing allow entry.
post.description:
approve turns a pending pairing code into a standing allow entry.

It is admin-gated: a SuperAdmin, or an admin of the caller's own org.
The first approval an org ever makes also seats its owner, reported as
ownerBootstrapped; every later one does not.
An unknown or expired code is not found, and nothing is written.

accessGroups.description:
AccessGroups REPLACES the org's named access groups, keyed group then
channel. Null leaves them unchanged.

channel.description: Channel is the transport id to edit: discord, slack, teams or telegram.

dm.description:
DM REPLACES the config-source DM allowlist.
Null leaves it unchanged; approved pairings are a different source and are
never revoked by this edit.

dmPolicy.description:
DMPolicy sets who may DM the org: pairing, allowlist or open.
Empty leaves it unchanged.

group.description: Group REPLACES the config-source group allowlist. Null leaves it unchanged.

groupPolicy.description:
GroupPolicy sets group and thread access: open, allowlist or disabled.
Empty leaves it unchanged.

accessGroups.description: AccessGroups is the org's named access groups, keyed group then channel.

dm.description: DM is the config-source DM allowlist — the entries this endpoint owns.

dmPolicy.description: DMPolicy is who may DM the org on this channel.

group.description: Group is the config-source group allowlist.

groupPolicy.description: GroupPolicy governs group and thread surfaces on this channel.

paired.description:
Paired is the pairing-source entries, read-only here: they are minted by
approving a pairing and cannot be edited away by a policy write.

channels.description:
Channels is every transport in the closed registry, in fixed order —
present whether or not the org has connected it.

account.description: Account is the connected account's external id, lower-cased.

accountLabel.description: AccountLabel is that account's human label — never swapped with Account.

capabilities.description: Capabilities is what the transport renders natively.

connected.description: Connected reports whether this org has an authenticated connection to it.

dmPolicy.description: DMPolicy is who may DM the org on this channel: pairing, allowlist or open.

groupPolicy.description: GroupPolicy governs group and thread surfaces: open, allowlist or disabled.

id.description: ID is the transport id: discord, slack, teams or telegram.

pendingPairing.description: PendingPairing is how many unexpired pairing requests await approval here.

cursor.description:
Cursor is the last row id in this page — pass it back as since.
An empty page returns the cursor it was given.

messages.description: Messages is the page, oldest first.

account.description: Account is the connected account that received it.

channel.description: Channel is the transport the message arrived on.

id.description: ID is the row id, and the cursor to resume from.

replyTo.description: ReplyTo is the message this one replied to, when any.

roomId.description: RoomID is the transport's room identifier.

roomKind.description: RoomKind is dm, group or thread.

sender.description: Sender is the transport-side sender identity.

senderUser.description: SenderUser is the Hanzo user it maps to, when one is known.

text.description: Text is the message body, downgraded to text.

channel.description: Channel is the transport the request arrived on.

code.description: Code is the pairing code shown to the org, exactly as issued.

ownerBootstrapped.description:
OwnerBootstrapped reports that this approval also seated the org's first
owner — the one-time bootstrap, false on every later approval.

sender.description: Sender is the transport-side identity now allowed to DM the org.

pending.description: Pending is every unexpired request awaiting an admin decision.

channel.description: Channel is the transport the request arrived on.

code.description: Code is the capability string shown to org members for approval.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is unix seconds of the first sighting.

lastSeen.description: LastSeen is unix seconds of the most recent sighting.

sender.description: Sender is the transport-side identity asking to be paired.
